name: Timerend deals its own native periodic damage (#514)
contract: Timerend 707430 (SPELL_AURA_DUMMY, no trigger) is a talent-tree keystone, not a proc; the generic, class-agnostic AscensionCompatData::TalentReplacements row {22, 32, 707430, 520175, {801291, ...}} (AscensionTalentReplacementData.h) is the same, already-proven mechanism used for Artificer's Wand, and transforms Wand of Time into Timerend once spec 32 is active. This scenario proves the second half of the tooltip directly: Timerend's own damaging rank (801291) is a plain SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_DAMAGE (aura 3) effect, a native, unscripted mechanic, learned directly as fixture setup. The transformation itself is verified by code trace only: `.localspec 32` does switch the character's local specialization (confirmed via the server's own 'Synchronized ... with local specialization 32' log line), but the subsequent learn-triggered SynchronizeTalentReplacements call did not grant 801291 in this harness in two learn orders tried, mirroring the same unresolved harness/local-spec interaction already flagged for the sibling Artificer's Wand case (#515) in the Time sub-batch.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Timerend's own periodic damage aura lands on the target
Let at least two 1-second ticks land
Timerend's periodic tick deals real damage
